informal_statement: For \(0<\lambda<1\), the type-\(\mathrm B\) radius is strictly decreasing on its whole admissible angular domain.
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:103-119`: The formal set is all `BAdmissible` angles, including \(\beta =\pi -\arccos (\lambda )\). The proof combines the global cotangent identity with a positive square-root coefficient; the author's whole-domain strict decrease is exact.
